A library imports another library by its package name, and app code not at all.
The root's own dependency resolves from any package, so a package reaches it only by declaring it: the sandbox runs in Node, for the runner and the repository's scripts.
Browser code imports only a library's browser subpaths: /pty, /host, /server, /electron, /browser/host, /shell and /headless run in Node.
